metadata.name: Infinite Task Loop
metadata.description: Interactive open-ended session for a live sequence of tasks that are not known in advance. It reuses an already stated current task or asks for one, creates a proportionate task-scoped plan, waits for explicit user plan approval, executes and verifies only authorized work, presents a factual result, and waits for explicit acceptance before returning to next-task intake. Plan revision and result rework both require non-blank feedback and return through the plan gate; each new task atomically clears the prior current plan and result so exit cannot mix iterations. The native exit teleport is available from every step and returns only a bounded truthful session summary, disclosing any history that is no longer observable. State lives only in execution context: there is no durable task ledger, filesystem artifact, crash-recovery contract, or independent reviewer. Plan approval never broadens the original task authority, and separately sensitive side effects still require task and host authorization. Choose Infinite Task Loop for a human-guided stream of not-yet-known tasks. Choose Quick Task for one bounded independently reviewed task, Robust Task for durable recovery and retry, Todo List for a finite known checklist, or Software Development Flow for full software delivery. This workflow is intentionally interactive and is not for unattended batch work.

nodes.directive:
Obtain the next task for this live interactive session. If the user already stated a concrete task in the request that started or continued this workflow, reuse it without asking again. Otherwise ask what they want done next and wait for the actual answer. Preserve the user's meaning and constraints in task_description; do not plan, inspect, or execute the task yet.

A request to stop, exit, leave, or finish the session is not a task. In that case do not submit task_description: call step for this execution with teleportTo "teleport-exit" and no input.
nodes.completionCondition: One concrete non-exit task has been captured faithfully from an existing explicit request or the user's actual answer, without planning or execution
A proportionate actionable plan for the current task exists, covers its constraints, authority boundaries, risks, and observable verification, and no task work has been executed
The user has actually reviewed the current plan and explicitly approved it or supplied non-blank revision feedback, with no execution performed

plan_decision.description: The user's actual decision on the current plan

user_feedback.description: Required non-blank user feedback when the plan must be revised

nodes.completionCondition: The current plan has materially changed to address the user's non-blank feedback while preserving task scope and authority, and no execution has occurred

The authorized current task has been executed to the extent actually possible under the approved plan, proportionate verification has been performed, and the execution summary truthfully distinguishes completed work, failures, and blockers
The user has actually reviewed the factual current result and explicitly accepted it or supplied non-blank rework feedback

result_decision.description: The user's actual decision on the current task result

user_feedback.description: Required non-blank user feedback when the result must be reworked

nodes.completionCondition: A materially changed replacement plan addresses the rejected result and non-blank user feedback for the same task without execution

nodes.hint: Use when the user explicitly wants to stop, exit, leave, or finish this interactive task-loop session
nodes.completionCondition: A bounded truthful session summary has been produced; it reports only observable completed work and explicitly discloses any unavailable earlier history

execution_plan.description: Current task plan; empty only between successful task intake and its plan writer

session_summary.description: Truthful bounded exit summary based only on observable session work

task_description.description: Exact current non-exit task supplied by the user

execution_summary.description: Current task execution summary; empty until the current task has been executed
